content: Wrapping MCP servers in proxy middleware commonly fails due to three issues: stream consumption, health-probe auth blocks, and SSE timeout. First, middleware like onUnhandledRequest in mcp-proxy 6.x consumed the request stream body before MCP stream handlers could read it, breaking POST requests. Second, requiring authentication on /health or /healthz endpoints crash-loops container environments (like Azure Container Apps or K8s). Third, dropping session headers or TCP timeouts on idle SSE streams breaks downstream clients.
